name: Elgee Park
signature: A pioneering Merricks North wine estate; the property is closed to the general public, with wine tastings at Merricks Store.
editorNote: Elgee Park says its estate is closed to the general public. Community groups can arrange a vineyard and sculpture-park tour with the operator. Its wines are available for tasting and sales at Merricks Store, 3460 Frankston-Flinders Road, Merricks. Do not travel to the estate for an ordinary cellar-door visit; check the operator for any arranged tour.
whyWeGo: A pioneering Peninsula wine producer whose wines can be tasted at Merricks Store.
ifOnlyOneThing: Visit Merricks Store for an Elgee Park wine tasting; contact the estate before any group tour.

heroImage.alt: Rows of trellised vines in early leaf running across a slope to a tall cypress windbreak.
